d:
Ty Jerome erupted for 40 points, 5 rebounds, 5 assists, and 5 threes, scoring 17 of Memphis’ final 19 points from the closing minutes of regulation through overtime. Despite his historic performance, the Grizzlies fell 135-134 to the Pelicans, suffering their first loss of the season. Jerome now has two 40-point games this season and joins Ja Morant as the only players in franchise history with multiple 40-point, 5-rebound, 5-assist performances!
